visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with reddish-brown bangs and long hair, wearing black sunglasses as a headband and a white top with a red Haidilao apron, stands in a brightly lit restaurant. She holds a smartphone displaying social media comments, pointing at the screen with an excited facial expression and open mouth. Behind her, other diners and the warm, wooden interior of the restaurant are visible. (2) The scene shifts to a close-up of a plate of golden-brown, deep-fried noodles piled high. The woman picks up a piece with her fingers and dips it into a small white bowl of condensed milk. She takes a bite, her eyes widening in delight, and gives a thumbs-up. (3) The camera focuses on a bowl of translucent, amber-colored kudzu root starch noodles. The woman uses tongs to lift the slippery noodles into a bowl of thick sesame sauce. The background shows a self-service condiment station with various sauces and toppings in stainless steel containers. (4) The woman demonstrates a complex food preparation. She spreads out a rectangular, thin sheet of fried bean curd skin on a black plate. Using chopsticks, she carefully places a slice of raw marbled beef and a dollop of gray shrimp paste onto the skin. She rolls it up tightly with her hands, showing the completed roll to the camera. (5) In the final phase, a montage displays the three dishes side-by-side. The woman is seen eating the cooked rolls with a satisfied expression. The video ends with a wide shot of her walking towards the entrance of a Haidilao restaurant, which features a glowing red logo and digital menu screens.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 海底撈火鍋 Haidilao Hot Pot. [Subtitle]: 海底撈隱藏吃法大公開. (2) [Variety]: 妳又不常吃海底撈. (3) [Subtitle]: 就因為我不常吃，所以我特別上網做攻略. (4) [Subtitle]: 我選出了3種我自己覺得，一定會好吃的吃法. (5) [Slogan]: 隱藏吃法#1 糖蜜炸撈麵. (6) [Subtitle]: 撈麵備註要炸的. (7) [Variety]: (咔滋). [Slogan]: 開聲音. (8) [Subtitle]: 超級對味. 超級好吃. (9) [Slogan]: 隱藏吃法#2 麻醬葛根粉. (10) [Subtitle]: 葛根粉煮3分鐘. [Variety]: 調製靈魂醬汁. (11) [Subtitle]: 麻醬2勺, 醬油1勺, 醋1勺, 鹽1勺, 糖1勺, 辣椒、蒜泥 些許. (12) [Subtitle]: 海底撈你可以改賣麻醬葛根粉了, 一口入魂. (13) [Slogan]: 隱藏吃法#3 肥牛蝦滑響鈴卷. (14) [Subtitle]: 攤開響鈴卷, 放入牛肉, 煮3分鐘 (清水or麻辣都可以). (15) [Subtitle]: 我是覺得嚐鮮還不錯. (16) [Subtitle]: 我最愛糖蜜炸撈麵. 歡迎留言推薦給我呦.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, energetic female voice speaking rapidly in Mandarin over an upbeat, synthetic pop BGM with a steady 4/4 electronic drum beat. The atmosphere is cheerful and loud. (2) A distinct, sharp 'crunch' sound effect (foley-style) triggers as the narrator demonstrates eating the fried noodle, followed immediately by her saying 'Super delicious' with a rising, excited pitch. (3) The background music continues with rhythmic synth pads while the narrator's voice drops slightly in pitch but increases in detail as she lists sauce ingredients. A soft 'slurping' sound is heard briefly. (4) A 'pop' bubble sound effect signals a transition. The sound of plastic rustling and the metallic clinking of tongs are audible as she prepares the beef rolls. The narrator's tone remains friendly and professional. (5) The final phase features the BGM swelling in volume during a quick montage of food shots, accompanied by a 'ding' sound effect. The video concludes with the narrator's voice at a high arousal level, inviting viewers to comment, before the audio cuts off cleanly.
